title: ADR (mirror of cloud ADR-0081): Organization management — the open basics half (D1 invitations stay open, D3 org record page, D4 org-scoped `sys_member`), recorded in this repo with Provenance
body:
Part of #14496 (maintainer ruling 2026-09-02, 「ok」 to option 2: mirror the open half, do not move files). Filed by the director seat, session `session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk`. `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface: **draft PR, human merge**. Clause-②: no. `domain:*` is triage's.

## What to write

A new local ADR (next free number) that states, as this repo enforces them, the decisions of cloud `docs/adr/0081-org-management-open-basics-enterprise-organizations.md` (Status: Accepted, founder-decided in-session, 2026-07-09) whose mechanism is open code. From the cloud record's own headings, the open half is:

- **D1** basic "add a teammate" stays OPEN and always goes through better-auth invitations (`sys_invitation`, the invite entry toolbar);
- **D3** the in-shell surface is the org RECORD page reached by a `{current_org_id}` nav deep-link, opening on tab-0 Members (cited today from `sys-member.object.ts:47`, `invite-entry-toolbar.test.ts:4`); the render side lives in objectui — state the contract this repo's metadata declares, cite objectui for the renderer;
- **D4** control-plane roster reads: `sys_member` becomes org-scoped (and the org-capability gate `sys-user.object.ts:59` cites as "ADR-0081 D1").

**Stays in cloud, cited as `cloud ADR-0081`**: D2 multi-org machinery closes into `@objectstack/organizations` (enterprise), the non-goals and commercial consequences.

## Shape (copy `docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md`)

`## Provenance — read this before citing this file` first (original decision in `objectstack-ai/cloud` ADR-0081, 2026-07-09; the enterprise half stays there; this file written from the cloud record and the implementing code — `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts`, `sys-user.object.ts`, `sys-invitation*`, the org-scoping service gate). Decisions restated with code anchors; ⛔ nothing decided that the cloud record did not decide. Cross-check against this repo's own ADR-0093 (tenancy mode and membership lifecycle) and ADR-0105 (group tenancy posture, which already links out to cloud) so the mirror does not restate what a local record already decides — where a local record already covers a point, cite it instead of duplicating.

## Follow-ups the accepting seat files (not this card)

- cloud repo: one-line pointer on cloud ADR-0081 naming the new local number.
- #14361 re-points the identity surface's bare `ADR-0081` citations (≥ 3 measured; the dev reads each — `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**`, `plugin-auth`) to the new number; ⛔ not done here.

Refs: #14496 · #14361 · cloud ADR-0081 · ADR-0093 · ADR-0105 · ADR-0079.
